fields.description: Skyscape Aura is a residential tower in Sobha Hartland II’s Skyscape collection. Its apartment plans range from one to three main bedrooms, with additional configurations marketed as 1.5 and 2.5 bedrooms and different community, lagoon and city-facing orientations.

overview: The reviewed two-bedroom Type A separates a shared powder room from the main bathrooms, while the three-bedroom Type A adds a maid room. Saleable totals include balcony areas and differ from enclosed suite sizes.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha Hartland II in Dubai. Confirm the selected level and outlook; a plan’s view label does not guarantee an unchanged future skyline or access rights to neighbouring lagoon facilities.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 1.96 m, subject to inventory. Property Finder retains a different original starting guide. Request the actual unit’s price, inclusions and availability rather than applying either headline to every apartment.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% down payment at launch, 40% construction and 40% handover. No current dated developer calendar was retrieved; confirm milestones, fees and any remaining balance for the selected unit.
research.handoverNote: Estimated timing; confirm the signed unit agreement.
unresolved: No signed current instalment/handover schedule, confirmed inventory, parking allocation or service-charge rate retrieved.
Marketing 1.5/2.5 labels require the selected approved drawing; extra service/study rooms should not be assumed to be full bedrooms.
The catalogue’s currently offered size range is not the complete brochure unit mix. Illustrative views, fixtures and floor plans may change. Images remain illustrative.
